core_obligations: (1) implies (2): take a quasi-compact stack mapping to the target, present it by a quasi-compact scheme, and note that the base change of the representable quasi-compact morphism along that presentation is a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces; the base change of the presentation is smooth and surjective, so quasi-compactness descends (proof lines 1932-1950)

(2) implies (1): for a morphism from a scheme, quasi-compactness of the morphism of algebraic spaces is checked after restricting to affine opens, whose preimages are quasi-compact by assumption (2), and the local criterion finishes (proof lines 1952-1960)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：把准紧的 Z 用准紧概型 U 满光滑展示；f 可表示且准紧 ⇒ U ×_Y X → U 准紧，再由满光滑下降得 Z ×_Y X 准紧。
(2)⇒(1)：对概型 Z 检验，取仿射开 U ⊂ Z，U ×_Y X 由 (2) 准紧 ⇒ p 准紧（代数空间准紧的局部判据）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces is quasi-compact if and only if every base change of it along a morphism from a quasi-compact algebraic stack is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 1918-1929, label lemma-characterize-representable-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 1931-1961) proves the forward direction by presenting a quasi-compact test object and descending quasi-compactness along a smooth surjection, and the reverse direction by testing affine opens and applying the local criterion for quasi-compactness of a morphism of algebraic spaces (proof lines 1932-1960). The reduction to presentations and the local test on affine opens are the content. H3.
